evidence.excerpt: Adobe reported record Q2 FY2026 revenue of $5.87 billion, up 11% year over year. Digital Media ARR grew to $18.4 billion; remaining performance obligations (RPO) reached $19.9 billion, up 13% year over year.

For the quarter ended May 29, 2026, revenue was $5.87 billion. Cash flows from operations were $2.15 billion in the quarter and $4.6 billion for the first half of fiscal 2026; capital expenditures remained under 1% of revenue.
